steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: W-what is this place?
The girl's voice trembles a little as she tries to contain her unease.
This is the interrogation room, where you will be interrogated for your crimes.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Ah...
She seems to have been startled by the sudden glare.
Speak! Tell me your name, the crimes you committed, and why you committed them!

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: My name is Ariel and I... I'm sorry! It was all my fault! You must be very troubled...
She keeps apologizing and is on the verge of tears, unable to calm down and answer your questions. Looks like you have to change up your approach.
Please don't be afraid, Ariel. You only need to answer a few questions. The MBCC will protect your dignity as a citizen of the DisCity.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Okay...
Her hands are clenched, as if unable to fully relax. You continue to slow down your approach.
Moving on, I just need you to confirm some details, so I can get a better understanding of the case. Is that okay?
She gives a jittery nod.
Do you know why you are here?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Yes, I used my mutated power in front of some FAC officers.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I hurt them and interfered with their cleaning of Mania...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I didn't mean it... I-I just wanted to protect that girl. I didn't know it would turn out like this...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I'm sorry! I'm really sorry!
She doesn't seem comfortable with this kind of questioning and is made incoherent by the oppressive atmosphere.
You mentioned that you wanted to protect a girl. Who is she?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I... I don't know her.
Not even her name?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: It all ended before I could ask.
Where did she go after you saved her?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Maybe... Syndicate?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Sorry, I'm not really sure...
Ariel seems apologetic for being unable to give any clear answers. She uneasily waits for your reprimand.
Do you know what would happen if a Maniac got away?
What if she deteriorates into a Corruptor? What if the contamination spreads to other people?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I understand, Chief. I was too impulsive!

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I saw seven or eight adult male guards with batons going after her.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: She was cornered. She could only beg for the guards' mercy.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: She curled up on the ground, her nails deeply embedded into it. She was bleeding a lot...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I could see that she was trying her best to hold back her Mania, but those guards wouldn't stop. They even...
Ariel's face turns red as if remembering something embarrassing.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: They even humiliated her with wanton slurs.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Saying that her high M value was due to a filthy mind...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: But she did not resist even after that.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: In that moment of desperation, a ball of light appeared—I'm not sure how—in my hand like this...
Warm blue light rises from Ariel's hand and gathers into a ball before fading away.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Even if the girl were a Maniac, even though I don't know her...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I felt that she might be kind, no? Or at least, kinder than those who bullied her...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Sorry, I took the liberty of judging others.
Ariel lowers her head like a child caught by her parents doing something wrong, waiting again for your reprimand.
She does not seem to be lying, but there is a clear contradiction between her stance on Mania and her family.

We've investigated. You're from the Spencer family, correct?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: You already knew it?
It is a very prestigious family in the Eastside business world. It's been providing a lot of financial support in removing the Mania in Eastside.
You might just happen to have the same name, but the dress you're wearing now is not something an ordinary family could afford. Am I correct?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I didn't mean to hide it!

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I just don't want my father to know... He loathes Mania.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: He believes Mania is the source of all crime and Sinners are the evilest and most dangerous creatures in the world...
Do you feel the same way then? You just shielded an infected person.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Me...? I don't know...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I think people's nature might not be defined by their wealth or their health conditions.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Yet I would be scolded by my father every time I said that, and he would say I'm the dumbest child of the Spencer family.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Nevertheless, I'm sure he never expected me to be so stupid that I turned myself into a Sinner by helping a Maniac.
She looks at her hands in a daze as if still unable to believe she has a special ability.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I acted so impulsively for a stranger and ended up getting myself involved.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: And now I even gave so much trouble to you and everyone else in the MBCC... I know I'm worthless. I'm sorry.
You just subconsciously helped the weak, and that's not deplorable by itself.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Those guards...
I will deal with them impartially. I'll also follow up on the girl's situation as much as I can.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: That's good then. Thank you.
She smiles and breathes a sigh of relief for the sake of the stranger.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I wonder how that girl is doing in Syndicate. I heard that place is full of gangs. Will it be dangerous for her?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Will her Syndrome M get more tolerable?

options: Don't you have anything to think for yourself?

choices.text: Don't you have anything to think for yourself?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Huh?
Ariel shows a surprised look at your question. She took into consideration the stranger girl, the MBCC, her father, and her family.
But she never thought about her own situation.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I just don't want be a liability to others.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: As long as the Spencers don't know my whereabouts, they will not be implicated in the matter of Sinners.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Father would also not be angry and hurt for what I did—saving a Maniac...
She mutters to herself.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Yes... this is fine. It doesn't matter even if I disappeared.
Your ability will be useful in protecting the DisCity.
I'll bring your M value under control and let your ability play a role in protecting our city.
The MBCC and I need you.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Chief?
Ariel looks at you in disbelief and speaks anxiously.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: C-Could you please repeat that?
Ariel, you're definitely not worthless to me, the MBCC, and the girl that you protected.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I'm not?
Tears begin running down her cheeks. Both of you seem a bit bewildered.
Why are you crying?
She gently wipes the corners of her eyes and then looks at her wet fingertips.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Why am I crying? I-I don't know...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Maybe it's because I've never heard anything like this.
She clumsily tries to wipe the tears from her face but still can't help sobbing.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Weird... My tears just won't stop...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: So this is how it feels to be recognized...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: It looks like I can exist for more than just the sake of the Spencer family...
Years of pent-up frustration come out as she cries. Atmosphere in the interrogation room settles down. You give Ariel some time to process her emotions.
With no obstruction, no interruption, and no reprimand for losing her temper, she is finally able to vent her emotions.
She closes her reddened eyes and finally opens them after a long time. She looks straight at you.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Can I make a request for myself?
Of course.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I... want to go back to see my father. Perhaps this will be the last time...
